title: Type it once
caption: Ten small things float in Farhan's head. He types each once. Lumi tells his story.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz, Reminders in my own words: type something like 'call supplier Raju about cement Friday' and the app turns it into a task with a category and a due date, and the phone reminds the owner the evening before and the morning of, when notifications are allowed.

cast.farhan: Farhan, a young Indian grocery store owner with a short goatee, in a green t-shirt and a canvas apron

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a neat grocery store with shelves of packets behind her, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Lumi. This is Farhan's story. Ten small things float in his head, and some of them are important.
